profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Roblox
profile.summary: Experienced software developer with a demonstrated history working in the computer software industry. Skilled in C, C++, Python, Java, Swift and xCode, Linux, Algorithms, Artificial Intelligence, Web Development, Game Development, Adobe products, and many more. Strong media and communication professional with a Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science from Florida International University. Focused on creating innovative experiences and helping industries move ahead.

positions.title: Senior Technical Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Digital Games · C++ · Software Development · Software Design · Systems Engineering

positions.title: Co-Founder/Lead Developer
positions.description:
* Implemented back end business logic and some database designs
* Implemented and managed some front end designs and UX functionality
* Created and maintained initial business website
* Worked with speech recognition APIs, a native WebRTC implementation, and made extensive use of Cocoa Touch and other native iOS frameworks using Swift
* Coordinated with team members to create a seamless and engaging user experience
* Helped create and conceptualize SoundBite application

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
* Created and managed back end API and some of the front end interfaces using CakePHP and the Zend Framework.
* Documented original code and web application flow

positions.title: Editor
positions.description:
* Edited several music videos for Miami artists (exclusively cutting and small effects done on Adobe Premiere)
* Assisted in the production and implementation of cinema quality shots and effects
* Gained a intermediate understanding of Adobe After Effects and Adobe Premiere

projects.title: Sundown Engine
projects.description: A WebGPU engine for fun, games and research.

projects.title: Zenith
projects.description: Zenith is a free, open-source game engine that is currently undergoing active development. It comes complete with PBR, a custom UI system, a scripting system, a custom object format (.zof) for data-centric development and much more.
